map.基圆有什么意义？: What is the significance of the base circle?
map.基圆是渐开线齿廓的生成圆，压力角在基圆上为零；它决定渐开线形状，也是判断根切（齿: The base circle is the generating circle of the involute tooth profile, where the pressure angle is zero; it determines the involute shape and is also the geometric basis for judging undercutting (when the cutter cuts into the tooth root at too few teeth) and for computing the contact ratio.
